title: Free 3D Daisy Crochet Flower Granny Square Tutorial
author: Veronika Cromwell (Blue Star Crochet)
notes: start: original 'With Citrine create mc, 1 ch (doesn't count as a st) to secure the circle.' written as 'Make a magic ring.'. Between-round colour lines omitted (Citrine rnd 1, Light Pink rnds 2-4, Lime rnds 5-6, Peridot rnd 7). Rnd 4 note 'Pop the petals through the 3 ch-sp loops so they sit at the back' kept: the 3D effect is only the petals pushed forward; every stitch is a plain sc/ch/dc worked into stitches or spaces. Rnd 3 sc 'in the space between next 2 dc' written as sc@sp. Stated counts are not in parentheses on the page, so the checker does not read them; they agree with the DSL (R1 16 dc, R2 16 dc + 8 sps, R3 40 dc + 8 sc, R4 8 sc + 8 sps, R5 16 V, R6 20 V, R7 84 dc). Stitch graph: round 2 reads badly (cost 22.3); check where its stitches go.
